name: EXAMPLE — synthetic fuel combustion factors (NOT REAL DATA)

source.title: Synthetic values authored to exercise the catalog pipeline. Not derived from any published dataset.
source.license: MIT (same as the library) — these are invented numbers, not third-party data.

verification.method: None. This set exists only so the generator, the unit layer and the tests have something to compile against.
verification.notes: The release build refuses to pack any set whose status is not 'verified'. Replace this with a real, licence-cleared set (DEFRA/DESNZ under OGL v3, EPA eGRID public domain, Ember CC-BY-4.0) before publishing.
